name: Mike Stern Band
description: Legendary jazz guitarist Mike Stern brings his acclaimed band to the grand Sala Suggia for a night of world-class fusion and instrumental mastery.
longDescription:
On October 6, 2026, the Casa da Música's Sala Suggia will host the Mike Stern Band. Mike Stern, a Grammy-nominated guitarist, is recognized for his distinctive blend of jazz fusion, rock, and blues. His career spans decades, including significant collaborations with artists like Miles Davis, Jaco Pastorius, and the Brecker Brothers, establishing him as a prominent figure in contemporary instrumental music. This performance offers an opportunity to witness his technical prowess and improvisational skill in a live setting.

Attendees can expect an evening of intricate musical compositions and dynamic interplay between Stern and his band members. The Sala Suggia, known for its excellent acoustics and grand architectural design, provides a fitting backdrop for a high-caliber musical performance. The concert will appeal to enthusiasts of jazz, fusion, and instrumental music, offering a focused listening experience in a formal concert hall environment. The duration of the performance will be typical for a concert of this nature.

This is a ticketed event. Information regarding ticket purchase will be available through official Casa da Música channels. The Casa da Música is located in the Boavista area of Porto and is accessible via public transport, including the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), which is a short walk from the venue. Bus stops are also located nearby. Accessibility information for the venue can be found on the Casa da Música website.
